title: 비디오 컨퍼런스를 통한 학습: 가능성과 문제점

abstracts.value: The purpose of this study was to investigate potentials and problems of learning through videoconferencing. The Korean Government conducted an experiment between March 1995 and February 1998, for three years, connecting Nae-Chon Elementary School to Dae-Bong, Dong-Chang, Hang-Gok and Woa-Ya elementary schools by way of a videoconferencing system. The need for the study was due to student numbers in rural schools had declined and teacher numbers had been reduced as a result of families moving to cities for work. This particular study conducted during the third phase of the three year experimental study. Using videoconferencing in the Korean education system indicated other possibilities for videoconferencing, such as the opportunity for people living in rural areas to communicate with people from the cities, effective training of instructors and for meetings and conferences.
